delivered: Status filter chips (All, Open, Overdue, Due today, Upcoming, No date, Completed), each with a live count, plus a case-insensitive title search and a 'no tasks match' state with reset

Selected-task details panel: due status in words (overdue by N days / due today / due in N days / no date), created time, explicit Mark complete / Reopen, Edit, Delete (existing confirm dialog), Close details
Completed tasks are never reported overdue; the completed-at time is stated as 'not recorded' because Task has no such field
Day-rollover truth: 'today' refreshes at the next local midnight (single setTimeout, no polling) and when the window becomes visible again

Keyboard alternative: each title is a focusable button; Up/Down move selection and focus between tasks across groups; Enter/Space/click select; selection moves to the neighbour after delete so focus is not lost
Overdue badge carries text, not colour alone
Pure helpers exported from Tasks.tsx: taskGroup, taskMatches, filterCounts, daysBetween, dueSummary, groupTasks, TASK_FILTERS
interfaceProposals: No contract/schema change needed. If a completion time or manual order is wanted later, Task would need optional completedAt and order fields plus saveTask support; captain decision. Until then the UI states that completion time is not recorded and that ordering is by due date only.
limitations: No drag/reorder existed and none was added: there is no persisted order. UI says so.
Tests are static-render plus pure-logic plus source checks; there is no DOM in the repo test stack, so click/keydown handlers are not executed in tests. Typecheck covers them.
A due value stored as a full timestamp is bucketed by its date part (same as Home and search via dueKey), not converted to local time.
Selected-row highlight and title-button reset use inline styles because CSS files are not owned by this task; captain may move them into views.css.
'Clear completed' still deletes all completed tasks regardless of the active filter (the confirm dialog states the total count).
Task details sit in the right column, so on narrow single-column layouts they appear below the list.
Not run in the real Electron app or a browser; no screenshots taken.
